authorizes: NOTHING. No receipt is written by this file; recording starts only after the owner merges a writer and an input is ADMITTED or explicitly labelled research-only.
formalises: hierarchical-vs-direct-selection-comparison-v1 (docs/research-program/07-market-industry-stock-portfolio-hierarchy-ko.md §7, PROPOSED). §7.1 arms, §7.2 shared sample/cost rules and §7.3 estimators are adopted unchanged; this file freezes the numbers §7 left to registration.
historicalEvidence: KR history for this comparison is EXHAUSTED (integrated v1 compared A=S vs D=I+S on the same engine; AGENTS v2.47). US history needs I-2/I-3 and the #287 stock foundation. This contract is prospective-only.

arms.definition: regional ETF 100% (KR 069500.KS, US SPY); QQQ is a secondary US comparison row, never an arm
direct stock selection by market-relative stock score s_M
top industries by s_I, signal-date fixed cap-weighted industry baskets
industries by s_I, then names by within-industry s_S|I
within-industry s_S|I with industry weights matched to P0
rank on s_I + s_S|I in pre-fixed common units

sharedRules.informationTime: signal = last KRX/NYSE session of the week per weekly_decision; execution next session close; a receipt is valid only inside prospective_receipt_core.check_timing
sharedRules.eligibleSet: one (date, security) mask fixed before outcomes for all arms; common population restricted to industry-classified securities (the unclassified share is reported separately)
sharedRules.returnBasis: shareholder total return under the alpha-opportunity-model-v4 label-eligibility contract; unresolved terminal consideration => that arm's block None (NOT_EVALUABLE_BLOCKED_PATH), other arms unaffected
sharedRules.costs: pipeline.weekly_decision.trade_cost_fraction(region, date, side, is_benchmark) at 1x, 2x, 3x on the drifted prior book; the ETF residual leg is charged like every other leg
sharedRules.nameCountPolicy: Portfolio D: 0..5 names endogenous; 0 names => ETF 100%; residual weight => ETF, never cash; prior fixed 3/5/10-name books are controls only
sharedRules.concentration: max 2 names per sector (weekly_decision.MAX_NAMES_PER_SECTOR), per-name cap weekly_decision.NAME_WEIGHT
sharedRules.riskBudget: identical for all arms: no leverage, no shorting, equity notional 100% (stocks + ETF)

marketMultiplier.increment: comparison.multiplier_increment on the finished arm, reported separately; never selects an arm

comparisonFamily.multiplicity: Holm across the six pairs at 0.05; an unavailable pair is a p=1 slot

axes.predictive: rankWeightedSpread lower bound > 0 for P3/P5 scores over P1 (§7.3)
axes.economic: P3-P1 Holm-separated with positive mean AND P3-P0 point estimate > 0 at 2x cost
axes.notIndustryConcentration: P3-P4 does not explain most of P3-P1
axes.stable: same sign in both halves, KR and US, and by market state

decision.default: the simpler structure (P1, else P0) carries no burden; the complex arm must pass all five axes
decision.promotionGate: G6: only an arm whose inputs are ADMITTED and whose verdict passes may feed Portfolio D; otherwise P0

powerAndAccrual.mdeRule: MDE = (z_0.975 + z_0.80) * sigma_diff / sqrt(N_eff); with N_eff = 2/yr of non-overlapping H126 blocks, two years give N_eff = 4 and MDE ~ 1.4 sigma_diff: the first read is a feasibility read, not a verdict
powerAndAccrual.firstVerdictNotBefore: N_eff >= 8 non-overlapping H126 windows (about 4 years of receipts); earlier reads are descriptive

stockScore.KR: UNVALIDATED (Phase C/D 0 passes; challengers #277/#278 prospective, not matured)

industryScore.KR: UNVALIDATED (industry anatomy descriptive; KR membership foundation v4 DATA_FOUNDATION_INSUFFICIENT for terminated names)
industryScore.US: SOURCE_BLOCKED for history; sector-level PIT foundation see market_industry lane

inputEligibility.consequence: every arm except P0 is RESEARCH_PAPER_ONLY (KR P1) or BLOCKED_NO_QUALIFIED_INPUT; production stays P0: KR 0 names / 069500.KS 100%, US 0 names / SPY 100%

noRescue: Pairs, lags, alpha, cost model, name policy, horizons and axes are frozen here; changing any after a read is a new registration.
